// diagnostic

E1402

compiler-extension failed: {message}

What

compiler-extension failed: {message}

Why

The configured compiler-extension component could not complete `analyze`, or returned an invalid response (D-DX5-HOOK1). Guests are sandboxed; failures stay Jet-owned (I2).

Fix

Fix the component, or unset `JET_COMPILER_EXTENSION` to skip the extension.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1402: tests/ui/compiler_extension_host_failed.stderr.
